cards.title: Music Festivals With Kids Can Be Magical
cards.body: Parents who bring toddlers to music festivals create a vibrant family atmosphere that enhances the experience for everyone. Taking twins to festivals teaches children about community and shared joy while challenging outdated assumptions about family fun.

cards.title: Navigating Crushes While Married With Children
cards.body: Crushes can feel freeing because they exist outside everyday life, but acting on them requires careful consideration of your marriage and family. A therapist explores how to handle these feelings responsibly.

cards.title: Maternity Care Should Be Universal and Safe
cards.body: Ireland's shift from a two-tier maternity system to universal state care is overdue and critical for all mothers. Pregnant women deserve equitable access to safe delivery without financial burden.

cards.title: Children in Mental Health Crisis Rising
cards.body: NHS emergency departments are seeing increasingly young children, some as young as six, presenting with self-harm, eating disorders, and emotional distress. This alarming trend signals a growing mental health crisis among youth.

cards.title: ADHD and Autism Care Facing Crisis
cards.body: Healthcare systems are struggling to provide adequate care and diagnosis for children with ADHD and autism. The growing demand is creating chaos and long waits for families seeking support.
